subject.title: fix: match current tool error format in trace line sanitizer

question: Should the Axios security update be carried with this sanitizer PR after a current-head regeneration and fresh dependency authorization, or should the sanitizer fix proceed separately while maintainers land the dependency update through their owned workflow?
rationale: The sanitizer bug fix is narrow and proven, but accepting a root dependency graph change and its generated plugin artifacts is a repository security and release-process choice that cannot be resolved from code review alone.

options.title: Refresh and authorize the combined head
options.body: Rebase, regenerate the lock and shrinkwrap artifacts from the approved source, then obtain a fresh exact-head dependency authorization before merging both changes.

options.title: Split the dependency update
options.body: Remove the Axios graph changes from this PR and land them separately through the maintainer-owned dependency-update workflow.

recommendation.title: Refresh and authorize the combined head
recommendation.body: Rebase, regenerate the lock and shrinkwrap artifacts from the approved source, then obtain a fresh exact-head dependency authorization before merging both changes.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the current sanitizer and dependency commits and submitted the existing dependency-authorization requests.
